body:
I have been talking with Sally for almost a year now, about 10 journeys total.  All of my experiences have been strange to say the least.  I always thought the full blown trip reports were written by people with way overactive imaginations or they were just crazy, but today I finally realized that it is possible.  This was my first time working the 5x extract, I had an empty stomach and didn't get the usual hot-flashes.
I put some tranquil music on repeat and gave a short prayer.  I did not wish to meet Sally empty-handed so I decided to trade Love in exchange for her guidance.  This worked very well.  I sat down with a water pipe and a bic lighter and loaded about a 1/4 of a standard sized bowl with the extract.  I took one large puff, didn't feel anything but I sat back and closed my eyes.  Soon after I felt as though I was being observed or rather my thoughts were being observed.  Thinking became abstract as if it were not my own.  I'm now in Salvia Space with a strong dialouge.  3D shapes fly around me and I realize I can see through my eyelids.  During previous journeys I have always felt a downwards pressure and something I assume is like dying.  What better way to set the Astral body free?  She wants to take me with her, but I hesitate.  What if I get stuck here?  Can I return to my body?  I then feel like a little kid being left behind because they're not old enough to go somewhere.  So I mention that it's cool, I can handle it.  Slowly fade back to reality.  The reason why I couldn't go with was obviously because I didn't completely trust her and I brought a little fear with me.  I know I have much to learn but this was a big step.
Thank you, Sally.  I always like to write and draw afterwords because I feel a wealth of creativity.  The main difference i noticed between the 5x and the regular was the dialogue was much more clear and lasted longer.  I was back to my regular self with in half an hour while the journey seemed to last mere seconds.  I am so happy that I found out what was holding me back, she is a wonderful teacher for exploring the consciousness and should be treated with much respect.
